items.information:
## Português

* O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato.
* A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir.
* Alunos e funcionários da FECAP estão isentos da taxa de inscrição

***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 170 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.***

**Esta competição tem um limite de inscrições, portanto, caso tenha se inscrito e não possa mais participar, favor informar à equipe de organização, para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outro competidor.**

--------------------

## English

* The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab.
* The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition.
* Students and employees of FECAP will be waived from the registration fee.

***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 170 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.***

**This competition has a competitor limit, so if you have registered and will no longer be able to attend, please inform the organization team, so the spot can be given to another competitor.**

![Image description](https://i.postimg.cc/C1vLjXXn/logo-fecap.png)

items.name: Saint-Augustin A 2025
items.information:
## [FR]

### Série Saint-Augustin 2025

Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! 

Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents.

Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***.


### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

## [EN]

### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series

One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! 

You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets.

You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***


### Registration Reminders

You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Swisscubing Cup III ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus 8 Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, besuche unsere [Website](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2025/).

Teilnehmer die sich registrieren aber nicht bezahlen, müssen die Teilnahmegebühr bei ihrer nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen.

Swisscubing Cup III is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of 8 competitions during the whole year. Check out our [website](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2025/) for the details of the other editions.

A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.
______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup II fait partie de la Swisscubing Cup 2025, composé de 8 compétitions durant l'année. Jette un oeil sur notre [site web](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2025/) pour plus de détails sur les autres éditions.

## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025!

### Make sure you check out [Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025) taking place on May 30th - June 1st in Edinburgh!


### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. However, this is a blind events specialist events competition, so we do not recommend this competition to beginners or first time competitors.


#### Prizes:
As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ScottishChampionshipBlindOff2025#55048-prizes) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete.
